name: Virginia Woolf
q: Mrs Dalloway said she would buy the flowers herself
Books are the mirrors of the soul
Write what you wish to write
One cannot think well if one has not dined well
Life is not gig lamps symmetrically arranged
For most of history, Anonymous was a woman
As a woman, I have no country
Nothing has really happened until it has been recorded
I am rooted, but I flow
A woman must have money and a room
Lock your libraries; my mind is free
Arrange whatever pieces come your way
The future is dark; the best it can be
Yes — I have had my vision
Words do not live in dictionaries; they live in the mind
Unvanquished I fling myself, O Death!
